title: Repair the five bounded X-Bookmarks bin defects
originalRequest: Implement the five defects and six deterministic acceptance checks preserved in salvage/ZEI-1/ZEI-1-remediation-spec.md and salvage/ZEI-1/test_bin_defects.py without modifying the X-Bookmarks primary tree.
expectedOutputs: Root-relative batch and coverage CLI behavior
Flagged claims excluded from the recall floor
Resolved excerpt metadata persisted on valid claims
Justified skip records persisted to skips.jsonl
Requested claim fields rendered without changing default output
constraints: Consume the workspace and branch supplied by Paperclip; do not create, select, or switch a worktree or branch.
Do not modify /home/lucascoh/X-Bookmarks or any other primary worktree.
Do not read old bookmark bodies or derived corpus material to implement or verify these bounded bin defects.
Do not manually reassign the issue or its native execution stages.
The Engineer sandbox cannot commit; head may equal base when the receipt carries exact changed-path hashes and diff hash.

acceptanceCriteria.requirement: The complete repository test suite passes.
The --root batch and coverage paths operate on the supplied fixture root and emit root-relative note paths.
Flagged records never credit the recall floor while valid records still do.
Valid claims persist excerpt, excerpt_span, and excerpt_normalized through claims.jsonl.
skips.jsonl contains exactly the justified skips and excludes unjustified skips.
The view field passthrough emits requested values, tolerates absent optional fields, and preserves default output.
